data.content:
I couldn't log it: no meal plan covers 2026-01-20, so I have no planned dinner to pull from.

Tell me what the dinner was and I'll log it:
- the saved recipe name, or a description of the food
- servings
- whether you cooked it at home

I'll show you the full entry and log it once you say yes.

Chef keeps a short technical log on this machine of its own script runs: which script ran, how long it took and how it ended. It never records what you ask, recipes, or household, health or dietary details, and it never leaves this machine on its own. To turn it off, which also deletes it, say "turn off Chef's log". To report a problem with Chef, say "report a problem with Chef"; you see every line of the report, and nothing is sent until you say "send".
